complete_exchange_contexts.111: Donna recommends Santiago Cathedral while the party is visiting Seville. Preserve the long pilgrimage tradition,fame andoffer ofdirections;no surname orromantic relationship comes from city metadata.
complete_exchange_contexts.112: The priest welcomes pilgrims andoffers commemorative crosses. Hodram privately notices one unusually old cross butconceals his concern. Preserve the complete Christian prayer,not a generic invocation.
complete_exchange_contexts.113: A personality-selected companion draws attention toan object;an unidentified temple voice offers power andurges debate. The companion variants belong tothe same exchange andretain their source slots;do not name the voice ordeity.
complete_exchange_contexts.114: The Sphinx riddle has alternative claims andwrong-answer ejections,then a second twelve-person problem withtwo separately counted canes. Preserve allbranches andthe explicit animal clue. Gerhard initially follows the earlier three-leg image;Hodram explains four babies through feet/hands arithmetic. Reactions in alternate branches do not allhappen inone playthrough.
complete_exchange_contexts.115: A self-important megalithic research sect chants,plans revenge on a village,andis stopped after the party evacuates the villagers andsets traps. Charles,Manuel,Gerhard andEmilio each contribute to the trap comedy. Nearly one hundred followers are captured,not killed. Hodram offers a quiet surrender,then invokes the army's harsh judgment;no actual execution orknighthood is invented.
complete_exchange_contexts.116: An unidentified voice asks about its slain monstrous-fish servant andwhether Hodram rules the sea. He admits the deed butmodestly distinguishes his present status fromhis ambition. The voice urges him toclaim the seal he seeks andan ancient coin puzzles the party. Keep the voiced印綬/seal wording without inventing another named relic.
complete_exchange_contexts.117: An isolated community rejoices at fellow believers after fleeing Muslim rule. Hodram politely changes the subject tothe Proof ofConquest. The villager entrusts an ancient lamp required byseekers andpleads that the Proof stay outofthe Ottoman Empire's hands. Present the community's account andfaith respectfully without adding judgments about a religion.
complete_exchange_contexts.118: The Colosseum voice sets a doubling-bean problem:one initial bean fills the bag in60seconds. The three source choices lead totwo separate guesses andthe correct59-second branch. Gerhard's uncertainty belongs tothe wrong-answer branches;do not make it his universal character trait. The interface has three captions,not two.
complete_exchange_contexts.119: Personality-selected companions notice a dead end. An embedded urn-shaped tablet andinscription provide a left-hand pouring clue. Pouring withthe left hand implies tilting right;retain that distinction across the Push/Turn right/Turn left choices. Wrong actions canlead toflight andan anonymous sailor injury,not a named crew death.
complete_exchange_contexts.120: A senior monk recognizes a seeker of the Proof and asks about Hodram's military command. His account connects Japan's escape from the Yuan invasion, the emperor's naval ambitions and a keepsake. Preserve his historical and religious perspective, conditional inheritance and request to return with the object; no royal fleet ownership or named emperor is supplied.
complete_exchange_contexts.121: The party is leaving when a grandfather begs for his drowning grandson's rescue. Personality-selected companions spot the child and volunteer. Gratitude leads to a gift the grandfather earned defeating bandits in his youth. Hodram first declines that personal honor, then accepts at his insistence. Kinship is explicit here; the boy's familiar goodbye does not make Hodram his brother. Do not invent the grandfather's occupation.
complete_exchange_contexts.122: A personality-selected companion points out jade. Hodram admires it and Carlo explains its value in the New World and the East. Many offerings suggest the structure's importance; this is an inference, not archaeological proof or a statement that this particular jade is rare.
complete_exchange_contexts.123: The block contains linked but separate source-controlled exchanges: Hodram and Gerhard infer that a stone tablet was imported into a stone-poor region; Maria and Xien confront bandits prevented from raiding Sao Jorge. The bandits reveal their ruined village and revenge motive. Maria condemns slave traders and pillaging soldiers but rejects collective blame, explains the great powers' partition of the world and her search for the Proof, then invites the bandits to sea. They tentatively connect an object from the ruins. Preserve the faction macro and source controls; Maria is not relabeled as Hodram's crew.
complete_exchange_contexts.124: Benazir wants to repay a present with information about a remarkable building in India. Reaching it requires a map. Hodram appreciates the tip and intends to visit when able. No romantic relationship or broader destination replaces the source.
complete_exchange_contexts.125: A source-selected companion notices a statue. Eight personality alternatives comment on its mismatch with the building, then eight consider whether it was a figurehead or could serve as one. Hodram's short replies acknowledge the observation. Preserve the variants' questions, hedges and differing conclusions rather than making them a single asserted history.
complete_exchange_contexts.126: A villager says the discoverers have the right to the small blade. Rafael credits Hodram, whose cooperation made the discovery possible, but Hodram objects that taking it leaves Rafael no share. Claudio proposes giving Hodram the blade while Rafael's party takes all the job payment. Rafael is surprised and grateful; Hodram can earn money again. Preserve these two parties and the FI substitution; no new kinship or rank comes from polite address.
complete_exchange_contexts.127: Hodram orders departure, Manuel asks for a heading and Charles reminds him about sail handling. Native tutorial panels explain D-pad/stylus headings, L/R sail direction, automatic stylus trim, tapping the flagship to stop and the on-screen speed meter. Gerhard then threatens the Hanseatic fleet and Martin Speyer. Preserve instructions and prospective fighting rather than a victory already achieved.
complete_exchange_contexts.129: Diogo Escante first forbids trade, then claims he merely lent the Caribbean to the party. Hodram sees that Escante used their navy against his old enemy Maldonado. Escante announces an independent empire and his ambition to become its first emperor, claims exclusive New World trade rights and dismisses the party as no longer useful. Preserve alternate confrontation branches and his arrogance without making polite 殿 a noble title or the future empire an established sovereign state.
complete_exchange_contexts.130: Julio remembers his granddaughter Cristina and proposes bringing her along. He praises her swordsmanship and says she is in London; Hodram asks who she is, then where, and agrees to go. The relationship is explicit and the approved spelling is Cristina. Keep Julio's affirmative enthusiasm and Hodram's respect naturally.
